name: South Dakota
agency: South Dakota Department of Public Safety (DPS), Driver Licensing Program
permitAge: 14 (instruction permit, valid 5 years; 6 a.m.-10 p.m. with a licensed adult 18+ with 1+ year experience beside; 10 p.m.-6 a.m. only with parent/guardian beside - SDCL 32-12-11)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 in inclement weather and 10 after dark; parent attests in writing (manual p. 8; SDCL 32-12-11)
teen.holdPermit: 275 days, or 180 days after approved driver education passed with 80% on both parts (manual p. 8)
teen.nightLimit: Restricted minor's permit: 6 a.m.-10 p.m. with parent permission; 10 p.m.-6 a.m. only with parent/guardian beside, except direct route to/from school or school event, church, work, or farm work (manual p. 8)
teen.passengerLimit: Restricted minor's permit: first 6 months only immediate family/household (manual p. 8); after that at most one non-family passenger under 18 (DPS Teen Driver Pamphlet, eff. 7/1/2025)
teen.phone: Instruction and restricted minor's permit holders: no wireless communication device while driving (manual p. 8, 19). All drivers: texting, reading texts and social networking banned (manual p. 19); adult hand-held calls not addressed in the manual

notes: Handbook checked 2026-10-09: South Dakota Driver License Manual (English), printed 'REVISED 11/2024' (PDF last modified 2026-06-30), 72 pages; PDF page = printed page. Official manuals page: https://www.sd.gov/dps?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0043733
Full operator's license at 16 after 6 months on restricted minor's permit with no traffic convictions in prior 6 months (manual p. 8)
Permit holder under 16 convicted of a traffic violation or permit-restriction violation: 30-day suspension; second: 180 days or until 16 (DPS Teen Driver Pamphlet)

Knowledge test: 80% to pass (sd.gov DPS FAQ); the number of questions is not published on any official source found; knowledge test waived with an approved driver-ed certificate from the last year (Teen Driver Pamphlet)
Knowledge test may be taken in English or Spanish (SDCL 32-12-126, since 2021; SB 193 of 2025 only added an interpreter for the driving test). Drive-test instructions are in English

Move Over (manual p. 2): any stopped vehicle with amber/yellow/blue lights; multi-lane: move to farthest lane at least 300 ft before; two-lane: slow to 20 mph below the limit (5 mph if limit 20 or less)

School bus: manual p. 43 says always stop unless a physical barrier separates the road; SDCL 32-32-6 says opposite-direction traffic on a highway with 2+ lanes each way need not stop; stop at least 15 ft back. Conflict left unresolved (sd-022 stays medium)
